description:
Lists the watchlists on this account: named sets of companies, usually one per
client or project, with how many companies each holds and what has been spent on it.

A watchlist is not a watch. Nothing in it is scanned until companies are added or
a scan is requested. For a company you want followed continuously, that is
watch_company.

Cost: free — call it as often as you need.

include_archived.description: Also return archived lists. Default false.

name: list_watchlists
title: List Watchlists
